population: Every cert_est neutral-path action, unique day/market/side/rung/generation/decision_ms; statuses retained in build receipts; cert_ws sensitivity. No model fit or policy replay.
design: All 22 descriptors listed in committed source. Severe = value cents / client-known remaining shares <= earlier reserved day 1st percentile; all actions retained. Severe-vs-other-filled AUC is diagnostic only, not a training population. Matched on day, side, rung, floored edge, fixed P(fill) bands, earlier reserved-day score quintiles; add hour sensitivity and strict timing subset. Report every descriptor/day, no winner selection.
scale_tests: Per-day distributions/missingness of all 105 inputs; current 83 test inputs outside prior training min/max and 0.1/99.9 percentiles; all/good/severe/raw-kept groups. Quantify largest absolute 0.1% and 1% labels contribution to squared label magnitude/gross loss and test EV/filled-value-head squared error. No clipping or trimming.
controls: saved prediction identity and three corruptions
moving best with fixed order price
matched oracle AUC 1 and tied AUC 0.5
nulls: No significance/null-max claim or confidence interval. No random null experiment. These are descriptive diagnostics on already consumed data, not validation; a future claim requires separately frozen >=200-draw null and >=5 later untouched days.
limitations: depletion does not identify trade vs cancellation
same assumed knowledge clocks as cached model inputs, not newly host-receive certified
fixed-price depth outside visible five levels is missing
net flow ratio scale uses historical absolute net flow, not unavailable gross traded volume
pointwise associations do not prove incremental multivariate prediction or policy value
